integrity: A proof and exact standard-library checker support the finite classification; pre-existing deterministic connectivity indices are explicitly credited. The public literature comparison is incomplete where full source access failed. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted trees with at most eight vertices, identical independent patch survival p in (0,1), one certainly protected vertex, and ordered connected-pair objective including identical endpoints. No claims for cycles, weighted networks, correlated failures, varying patch values, multiple interventions or empirical performance.
title: Eight patches are sharp for survival-dependent shifts in optimal habitat protection
